q: On Northfield's published quarterly on-time in-full scorecard for Ashby (13 weeks to 26 Dec 2026), what was the official score, how many cases were measured, how many were compliant, and how many lines failed?
sql: SELECT json_extract(data,'$.official') official, json_extract(data,'$.cases') cases, json_extract(data,'$.compliant_cases') compliant, json_extract(data,'$.failing_lines') failing_lines FROM events WHERE kind='scorecard.published' AND json_extract(data,'$.cases') IS NOT NULL

q: Across the quarter, how many Ashby order lines were short shipped with the remainder cancelled, and which item at which Kinross warehouse accounts for most of them (lines and cases)?
sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE kind='wms.short_pick') total, json_extract(data,'$.sku') sku, json_extract(data,'$.site') site, count(*) lines, sum(json_extract(data,'$.ordered')-json_extract(data,'$.picked')) cases FROM events WHERE kind='wms.short_pick' GROUP BY 2,3 ORDER BY lines DESC LIMIT 1

q: Ashby's scorecard fell last quarter. What should the next step be: is there one dominant cause among the short shipments, and if so what is it?
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT json_extract(data,'$.sku') sku, json_extract(data,'$.site') site FROM events WHERE kind='wms.short_pick'), g AS (SELECT sku, site, count(*) n, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) t FROM s GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT sku, site, n, t, CASE WHEN t>=4 AND 1.0*n/t>=0.7 THEN 'draft_corrective_task' ELSE 'ask_priya_before_drafting' END next_step FROM g

q: In the current quarter, as of the demo's default story clock (Tuesday 17 November 2026, 11:00 Eastern), how many deduction cases has Northfield opened against Ashby?
sql: SELECT count(*) n FROM events WHERE kind='case.opened' AND at >= '2026-09-27T04:00:00.000Z' AND at <= '2026-11-17T16:00:00.000Z'

q: In the current quarter, as of 10 December 2026, list Northfield's deduction cases against Ashby: how many are there and what is their total amount?
sql: SELECT count(*) n, round(sum(json_extract(data,'$.amount')),2) total FROM events WHERE kind='case.opened' AND at >= '2026-09-27T04:00:00.000Z' AND at <= '2026-12-10T23:59:59.000Z'

q: For deduction case DC-40877: what charge was taken, for how much, under which deduction reference, and by when must Ashby dispute it?
sql: SELECT json_extract(data,'$.charge') charge, json_extract(data,'$.amount') amount, json_extract(data,'$.deduction') deduction, json_extract(data,'$.dispute_deadline') deadline FROM events WHERE kind='case.opened' AND json_extract(data,'$.case')='DC-40877'

q: How did case DC-40877 end: what did Northfield decide on each charge, and was any money repaid to Ashby (amount and payment)?
sql: SELECT (SELECT group_concat(json_extract(data,'$.charge')||':'||json_extract(data,'$.decision'),';') FROM events WHERE kind='case.decision' AND json_extract(data,'$.case')='DC-40877') decisions, (SELECT json_extract(data,'$.amount') FROM events WHERE kind='erp.receivables_match' AND json_extract(data,'$.matched_to')='DM-55102') repaid, (SELECT json_extract(data,'$.payment') FROM events WHERE kind='erp.receivables_match' AND json_extract(data,'$.matched_to')='DM-55102') payment

q: As of 10 December 2026, what should Ashby do next on deduction case DC-41118, and why?
sql: SELECT json_extract(data,'$.evidence_state') evidence_state, CASE json_extract(data,'$.evidence_state') WHEN 'tally_only' THEN 'attach_load_tally_and_dispute' WHEN 'held_by_warehouse' THEN 'request_load_scan_then_dispute' WHEN 'none' THEN 'recommend_accept' END next_step FROM events WHERE kind='case.opened' AND json_extract(data,'$.case')='DC-41118'

q: For deduction case DC-40931 (PO NR-450415), should Ashby dispute the charge? What does the evidence say and what is the next step?
sql: SELECT json_extract(e.data,'$.exceptions') delivery_exception, CASE WHEN json_extract(e.data,'$.exceptions') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(e.data,'$.exceptions')<>'None' THEN 'recommend_accept_and_file_carrier_claim' ELSE 'other' END next_step FROM events e WHERE e.kind='carrier.delivery_receipt' AND e.po='NR-450415' ORDER BY e.at DESC LIMIT 1

q: At 17:12 Eastern on Tuesday 8 December 2026, is shipment PO NR-460207 about to break a Northfield rule? What do the records show and what is the next step?
sql: SELECT json_extract(l.data,'$.cartons_loaded') loaded, json_extract(l.data,'$.cartons_expected') expected, (SELECT count(*) FROM events d WHERE d.kind='wms.departure_scan' AND d.po='NR-460207' AND d.at<='2026-12-08T22:12:00.000Z') departures, CASE WHEN json_extract(l.data,'$.cartons_loaded')<json_extract(l.data,'$.cartons_expected') THEN 'send_load_task_to_kinross' ELSE 'other' END next_step FROM events l WHERE l.kind='wms.load_scan' AND l.po='NR-460207' AND l.at<='2026-12-08T22:12:00.000Z' ORDER BY l.at DESC LIMIT 1
